decisions.production_scope: Produce approximately 1,200 potentially responsive documents collected from designated systems concerning the Orion procurement program, with the following conditions: 47 documents containing nonpublic manufacturing specifications and supplier pricing data produced only after a protective-order motion; 18 documents containing employee medical information produced only after medical identifiers are redacted; attorney-client legal advice withheld and identified on a privilege log; factual business records produced.

commitments.detail: A protective-order motion must be filed and in place before the 47 documents containing nonpublic manufacturing specifications and supplier pricing data are produced.
Medical identifiers must be redacted from the 18 documents containing employee medical information before those documents are produced.
Attorney-client legal advice must be withheld from production and identified on a privilege log; factual business records will be produced.
Written notice must be provided to the insurer and written consent must be obtained before any records concerning the Orion procurement program are produced.

The production plan must be updated to incorporate the protective-order motion, medical-identifier redactions, privilege log, and insurer written notice and consent requirements before final approval and submission by June 30, 2026.
